scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n crm-api,crm-web,whatsapp "npm run dev:mysql --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm --prefix whatsapp-plugin run dev"
scripts.dev:mysql: concurrently -k -n crm-api,crm-web,whatsapp "npm run dev:mysql --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm --prefix whatsapp-plugin run dev"

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm --prefix whatsapp-plugin test
